_comment: Retrieval evaluation set. Each question is asked in English; `expect` lists the
filename fragments that identify a correct source document (a match on any one
counts). `scanned` marks questions whose answer lives ONLY on pages with no
extractable text layer — those documents reached the old index solely through
Tesseract OCR, which mangled them, so they are the sharpest test of the change.
